title: Note Editor
summary: Everything you can do inside a single note.

cards.heading: What the editor does
cards.body: This is where you write, check things off, add photos, set reminders, and pick a colour. Every change saves to your device instantly — no save button needed.

cards.heading: Adding a checklist
cards.body: Tap **Add checklist item** to grow a to-do list inside any note. Tap the round box to tick items off. Long-press an item to reorder it.

cards.heading: Adding photos
cards.body: Tap the camera icon to snap a photo, or the paperclip to pick from your gallery. Photos live inside the note on your device — never uploaded.

cards.heading: Tip: Full-screen focus
cards.body: **Tip:** Tap the expand icon in the top-right to enter full-screen mode. Great for long writing sessions — every distraction disappears.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Closing the note saves automatically. If you meant to delete instead, use the trash icon — closing doesn't discard your changes.
